description: Copy community entries from one of your apps to another, server-side, payload included: each is published in the target AS YOURSELF (like neblla_publish_community_entry: users are per app, so the original authors cannot come along; their names stay in the source). Oldest first, and an entry whose parent is copied too keeps pointing at it (comments, versions, collections). Votes, favorites, reviews and reports stay with the source. The target needs the community module, and its rules apply (contentTypes, maxPayloadBytes). All the source's published entries (up to 500), or only `entryIds`. Returns `copied` ([{ from, to }]) and `failed` ([{ id, error }]).

entryIds.description: Only these entries (default: every published one)

name: neblla_copy_community_entries
title: Copy community entries
